profile.summary: A nonprofit that ran Urban Montessori Charter School, a public charter school in Oakland offering Montessori education. According to its website, the charter school closed after 12 years, and its work continues through the Public Montessori Institute of Oakland and Montessori classrooms at Brookfield Elementary.
